status: EXISTS — the media buyer is built against Workspace's own docs/contracts/workspace-door.v1.md (src/core/workspace-door.ts, src/server/workspace.ts, 18 checks in demo:mcp). Never run against a real Workspace yet.
direction: PUSH one way — the media buyer creates a person's open task in Workspace, then asks about it and closes it on its own side when the team finished it there. Workspace never writes back unasked, and the media buyer never edits or reads the team's own tasks.

auth.rule: System token — the OMS model (owner's decision, 17/11 17:30). The system that OWNS the data mints the token on its «الإعدادات ← توكنات الأنظمة» page: one token per consuming system, with named scopes and an expiry. The owner pastes it ONCE into the media buyer's «الإعدادات ← الربط» (write-only, AES-256-GCM at rest, never shown again — only «محفوظ ✓ · آخر 4 خانات»). The Bearer header on each call is unchanged. No OAuth flow between our systems.
auth.pasted_into: media buyer «الإعدادات ← الربط» ← row Zaki Workspace: WORKSPACE_API_TOKEN
auth.status: ADD (W1) — the page «توكنات الأنظمة» in Workspace, the same model as the OMS (system + scopes + expiry); the door itself does not change
auth.expiry: chosen when the token is minted (suggested 90 days). The media buyer does not store it: after expiry the system answers 401 and «اختبر الربط» says «انتهى أو انسحب» — the owner mints a new one and pastes it over the old.
auth.revoke: delete or rotate the token on the same page; the very next call is refused (401).

rate_limit: 60 per minute (429 → the media buyer stops the run and continues next time)

error_envelope.note: Workspace's door answers {error:{code,...}}; the media buyer reads only the status and `error.code`, never echoes a body

idempotency: `Idempotency-Key: mb-task-<taskId>` on every task creation: the same key creates the task once, however many retries. The same key with a different body is 409.

endpoints.change: Let Workspace issue the door token by consent («الميديا باير بدّه يضيف مهام ويقرا حالتها — اسمح؟») instead of the owner minting and pasting a key. The door itself (workspace-door.v1.md) is unchanged.
endpoints.size: small — reuses the door's key table and scopes

errors.when: API door switched off in Workspace
the board is not in the key's workspace
a field name that looks like customer data

endpoints.notes: Only words: no assignee, no customer, no price. The media buyer pushes a task only for a person (never for an agent), once, and not again after a refusal until somebody edits it.
Only a close comes back (`status = done` or a `finishedAt`): a reopened task is the owner's to move in the media buyer.

media_buyer.WORKSPACE_BOARD_ID: brd_example (only when the key sees more than one board)
media_buyer.note: WORKSPACE_API_TOKEN is entered on the site (sealed), not in Coolify

$comment: Written by the media buyer (docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md). A published version never breaks: only optional fields are added; a removed, renamed or retyped field is v2. No customer name, phone or address in any field, under any name.
